fr_html: M. FERNANDES constate qu'un certain nombre des membres du Comité se sont maintenant ralliés autour de l'amendement qu'il a déposé l'autre jour, mais qu'il vient de retirer.
en_html: M. FERNANDES stated that a certain number of the members of the Committee were now in favour of the amendment which he had submitted on a previous day, but which he had just withdrawn.
